evidence.field: File description; summary; source; permission; original file
evidence.text: The file description identifies 門-oracle.svg as a vector depiction of 門 in Shang oracle script style, cites Sinica Database among its sources, and states CC0 1.0. The page's Original file link resolves to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/37/%E9%96%80-oracle.svg. This is a modern vector redraw, not a photograph of an ancient object.
evidence.title: File:門-oracle.svg

evidence.source: 漢字構形資料庫 (Academia Sinica Character Database)
evidence.text: The record identifies the character as U+9580, indexes oracle-bone, bronze, Chu manuscript, and Small Seal forms, gives bronze reference 集成03136, and analyzes the graph as composed of two 戶 resembling opposing door leaves. This is the database's graphic analysis; its page does not state form-by-form dates in inspectable text. The site footer says All Rights Reserved, so this page is linked as evidence, not used as an image asset.
evidence.title: 漢字「門」：字形演變

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese Characters Database)
evidence.field: 字形分析; 甲骨文用例; 傳世文獻引申義
evidence.text: Search results report that oracle and bronze forms depict two door leaves, sometimes with a lintel in oracle-bone forms; oracle-bone examples use 門 for gates, including a temple gate cited from 《合集》32035. They also report later verbal and extended uses. The entry could not be opened directly during this run, so these search-result assertions are treated as leads rather than independently inspected full-page evidence. They do not establish a precise chronology for semantic extensions.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫—漢字甲骨部件分析：門

evidence.source: 說文解字 在線查詢
evidence.field: 說文原文; 字形演變; 段玉裁注 (dossier citation, not reopened in this run)
evidence.text: The repository dossier quotes the Han-dynasty dictionary account 聞也。从二戶。象形, which parses 門 as two 戶 and calls it pictographic. This is Xu Shen's historical explanation, not contemporary proof of original formation. This run did not reopen the cited page, so it is retained as dossier evidence only.
evidence.title: 「門」字的说文解字

gaps: The CUHK page could not be opened, so its oracle-bone citations and later sense reports remain unconfirmed in this run; no exact dated earliest attestation or semantic-extension chronology is claimed.

The competing analyses (a pictograph of a gate versus an analysis in terms of two 戶) remain unresolved. The supplied Shuowen account is retrospective; the inspected Academia Sinica record supports the two-leaf interpretation but does not establish the original design process.
The record does not establish whether any graphic variants reflect copying changes, scribal corruption, or stable historical alternatives.

Official Unihan kMandarin records for both simplified 门 and traditional 門 were inaccessible. No component pronunciation is involved because 門 is analyzed here as a whole pictographic graph, not a phonetic compound.
The relationship of simplified 门 to 門 is reported by the dossier and Dong Chinese, but no standards source documenting the standardization was inspected in this run.

Only one usable glyph candidate was established. The exact Commons description page and original URL are verified, but the image pixels were not visually inspected. The CUHK description page and the SVG fetch failure limit independent confirmation of the candidate's specific form.

items.period: Shang period script style, traditionally dated broadly to the late second millennium BCE; this is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 門 in a Shang oracle-bone script style, illustrating the early gate graph discussed in paleographic accounts.
items.alt: Black line drawing of an early 門 form on a plain background; pixel-level details have not been checked in this research pass.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the character and script style, names source collections, and provides an original image link with CC0 terms. It can illustrate the early graph while being explicitly labeled as a redraw.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on Commons; public-domain dedication

limitations.text: The candidate's file description and reuse terms were inspected, but the SVG pixels could not be fetched in the browser tool, so its exact visual details have not been checked.
